tasks.CountConsonantsFirstThird: Calculate the number of ways to choose two different consonants for the first and third positions from 20 consonants.
tasks.CountVowels: Calculate the number of ways to choose a vowel for the middle position from 5 vowels.
tasks.TotalCodes: Multiply the results from CountConsonantsFirstThird and CountVowels to get the total number of codes.
